name: MultiBet FullJRA StageA v0.4 Source Only

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  stagea:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    steps:
      - name: Reconstruct frozen source-only programs
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > extractor.py.gz.b64 <<'EOF_EXTRACT'
          
          EOF_EXTRACT
          base64 -d extractor.py.gz.b64 | gzip -d > extract_fulljra_speed_stagea_dbset_v0_4.py
          cat > completeness.py.gz.b64 <<'EOF_COMP'
          
          EOF_COMP
          base64 -d completeness.py.gz.b64 | gzip -d > audit_fulljra_speed_numeric_completeness_v0_1.py
          cat > median.py.gz.b64 <<'EOF_MED'
          
          EOF_MED
          base64 -d median.py.gz.b64 | gzip -d > audit_fulljra_par_median_robustness_v0_1.py
          echo '654a8c9aec768cda5a7c87f92054263466407ad8a43fcb9c62162577417315e9  extract_fulljra_speed_stagea_dbset_v0_4.py' | sha256sum -c -
          echo '696ba6274bc0ee1823851d4fa878c9da819ae49bee13e68bcce90225f6f4b401  audit_fulljra_speed_numeric_completeness_v0_1.py' | sha256sum -c -
          echo '3a0651c6609768b580b8fdd985218cb6fb55aef67c77b60ae4fa2ed9fdad97a9  audit_fulljra_par_median_robustness_v0_1.py' | sha256sum -c -

      - name: Download exact frozen KBlueLeaf DB
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          curl --fail --location --retry 5 --retry-all-errors --connect-timeout 30 \
            -o all_races_2005-2024.db \
            'https://huggingface.co/datasets/KBlueLeaf/jp-racing-horse/resolve/main/all_races_2005-2024.db?download=true'
          test "$(stat -c%s all_races_2005-2024.db)" = '717680640'
          echo '7828af205838d148f6bca70870d4ab152ea6b54430093dcf3159d23583252eab  all_races_2005-2024.db' | sha256sum -c -

      - name: Run dual-table Stage A outcome-closed
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python extract_fulljra_speed_stagea_dbset_v0_4.py --db all_races_2005-2024.db --outdir stagea
          python audit_fulljra_speed_numeric_completeness_v0_1.py \
            --normalized stagea/FULLJRA_FLAT_SPEED_REFERENCE_ROWS_2016_2020_v0.4.csv.gz \
            --support stagea/FULLJRA_FLAT_CONTEXT_SUPPORT_2016_2020_v0.4.csv \
            --out stagea/FULLJRA_SPEED_NUMERIC_COMPLETENESS_AUDIT_v0.1.json
          python audit_fulljra_par_median_robustness_v0_1.py \
            --normalized stagea/FULLJRA_FLAT_SPEED_REFERENCE_ROWS_2016_2020_v0.4.csv.gz \
            --support stagea/FULLJRA_FLAT_CONTEXT_SUPPORT_2016_2020_v0.4.csv \
            --outdir stagea/par_median

      - name: Assert predictive firewall
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python - <<'PY_GATE'
          import json, pathlib
          x=json.loads(pathlib.Path('stagea/FULLJRA_SPEED_STAGEA_GATE_REPORT_v0.4.json').read_text())
          assert x['status']=='PASS_STAGEA_SOURCE_COVERAGE'
          assert x['flat_race_count']==16639
          assert x['official_flat_set_authority_sha256']=='0040468145d620c6ffa06027fb9ec9926495b0817eb6d7ad22e9a9e9e10eaf02'
          assert x['source_flat_set_sha256']==x['official_flat_set_authority_sha256']
          assert x['ranking_used_for_feature'] is False
          assert x['odds_popularity_payout_exported'] is False
          assert x['target_winner_feature_use'] is False
          print('SOURCE_ONLY_STAGEA_PASS')
          PY_GATE

      - name: Seal output hashes
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          find stagea -type f ! -name SHA256SUMS_STAGEA_PACKET.txt -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 sha256sum > stagea/SHA256SUMS_STAGEA_PACKET.txt

      - name: Upload source-only evidence
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: multibet-fulljra-stagea-v0-4-source-only
          path: stagea/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 90

      - name: Cleanup raw DB
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: rm -f all_races_2005-2024.db
